agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
July 3, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for June 5, 2024, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Adam Bressler for
  Special Use Permit No. 23-00032 (SUP23-00032) to allow the
  conversion of an existing 11,550 square-foot, 3-story office
  building into a mixed-use building on an approximately 9,600
  square-foot, C-2 (General Commercial) / Art Deco Overlay and
  Mixed-Use Overlay zoned property at 3311 West Manchester
  Boulevard.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-007.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP23-00032.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Laverne Smith,
  representing Little Belize for Special Use Permit No. 24-00004
  (SUP24-00004) to allow the expansion of the on-site sale of
  distilled spirits and live entertainment in an existing
  commercial building on an approximately 8,600, H-C (Historic
  Core) zoned property at 217 East Nutwood Street.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-067.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP24-00004.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents
   c. A public hearing to consider an application by Nicole Jackson
  for Special Use Permit No. 23-00033 (SUP23-00033) to allow live
  entertainment in an approximately 1,404 square-foot proposed
  restaurant on an approximately 8,625 square-foot, H-C (Historic
  Core) zoned property at 213 East Nutwood Street.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-073.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP23-00033.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Adam Bressler
  for Design Review No. 24-00029 (DR24-00029) to allow exterior
  alterations to an 11,550 square-foot, 3-story office building
  on an approximately 9,600 square-foot lot on a C-2 (General
  Commercial) / Art Deco and Mixed-Use Overlay zoned property at
  3311 West Manchester Boulevard.

  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-007.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving DR24-00029.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 7a Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

  2
 In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of July 3, 2024, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 7, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
